sub: Choose the McDonough School of Business on your application. Georgetown's own app or the Common App: same essays, no preference.
Georgetown never went test-optional. Send one sitting or several; it looks at your highest section scores.
The prompt asks for your primary motivations for studying business at Georgetown. About one page. Make it specific to McDonough.
Your most meaningful activity, and a time you met a different viewpoint. Plus a 650-word personal essay.
Restrictive Early Action or Regular Decision. Every applicant is offered an alumni interview: say yes.
Start interview prep early. Free practice at mnaprep.com
